prose_tcp: Explain in detail how TCP congestion control works, including slow start, congestion avoidance, fast retransmit and fast recovery. Be thorough.
prose_pkc: Describe the principles and history of public-key cryptography, from Diffie-Hellman to RSA and elliptic curves, in a clear explanatory essay.
prose_sleep: Write an essay explaining why sleep matters for learning and memory, covering what happens in the brain during different sleep stages.
ja_tcp: TCPの輻輳制御の仕組みを、スロースタート、輻輳回避、高速再送、高速リカバリを含めて、日本語で詳しく説明してください。
ja_pkc: 公開鍵暗号の原理と歴史を、ディフィー・ヘルマンからRSA、楕円曲線暗号まで、日本語でわかりやすく説明してください。
ja_sleep: 睡眠が学習と記憶にとってなぜ重要なのか、睡眠段階ごとに脳で何が起きているかを含めて、日本語で解説文を書いてください。
coding_lru: Write a Python class LRUCache with get and put methods that run in O(1) time, using a dict and a doubly linked list. Include docstrings.
coding_debounce: Write a JavaScript function debounce(fn, wait) with a cancel method, plus a short usage example and comments.
coding_csv: Write a Rust function that parses one CSV line into a Vec<String>, handling quoted fields and escaped quotes. Include unit tests.
